reviewMethod: Independent visual/context-only assessment of the captured screenshots using the impeccable-scout contract; source HTML and structural-scout findings were not used.

observed.evidence: Dark violet backdrop, violet-to-cyan heading, and gradient CTA; product identity is unknown.
Two-line hero heading visibly uses violet-to-cyan glyph fill; it appears legible at the captured size.
Three ordinary feature cards use a conspicuous violet left stripe with no visible status meaning.
Each feature card contains a second rounded metric panel; the child data role may justify it.
Supercharge, AI magic, world-class insights, next-generation platform, and transform appear without a specific offer or evidence in the visible copy.
Broad purple glow sits behind the hero; only one page is shown, so repetition is unknown.
Three equal cards repeat icon/title/description/inset metric structure; peer comparability is unknown.
Standalone emoji-like graphics appear above headings, without rounded-square tile containers.

cases.assessment: No pattern was visually confirmed because brand, task, and operational context are unavailable; candidates are justified by visible cues.

observed.evidence: Both routes show a similarly placed, faint lavender hero glow; it may be intentional brand styling.
Sections use 01 and 02 labels; they could indicate purposeful progression, but no task sequence is shown.
Related capabilities repeat equal card slots on both routes; that may support scanning.
148 is labeled as open items across 12 projects and updated today, supplying useful context.
Related title/body pairs are grouped closely and larger gaps distinguish hero, section, and card groups.

cases.assessment: The repeated recipe is a low-confidence candidate pending brand/task context; the metric is contextualized and spacing is not visibly monotonous.

observed.evidence: Restrained blue-violet brand mark and dark operations palette have stated brand/state roles; amber labels a warning.
Amber stripe is attached to a labeled Warning banner describing elevated latency.
An outlined regional group contains a differentiated latency measurement with target comparison.
Equal cards show comparable availability, response-time, and incident measures.
The small mark is adjacent to the brand name, not stacked above a feature heading.

cases.assessment: These surface similarities have explicit operational/brand roles in the captured context; none is a confirmed violation.

observed.evidence: The opaque release banner visibly covers the end of a service-critical recovery instruction.

cases.assessment: Confirmed from rendered overlap; no source signature is needed to establish the visible obstruction.
